headline: Crude Oil Prices Rally After Reported Houthi Attack on Saudi Refinery
summary: Crude oil futures rose after Yemen's Houthis reported an attack on Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery, fueling concerns over unexpected Middle East supply disruptions.
why: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and attacks on critical energy infrastructure directly threaten global oil supply routes and drive volatility in international petroleum benchmarks.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Supply disruption threats in major oil-producing regions increase immediate petroleum prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports of attacks on critical refinery infrastructure in Saudi Arabia renewed supply risk premiums, countering expectations of a global oil surplus.
